{"consolidated_memory":"PLAN DRIFT IN infra/terraform/vpc.tf - FOUR SEPARATE INCIDENTS WITH DISTINCT ROOT CAUSES

Common context: All four incidents involved plan drift in the VPC module (same corner of infra/terraform/vpc.tf as earlier work). All manifested as a diff on a resource nobody edited, reproducible by running plan twice with no changes in between. All were infrastructure-side work.

INCIDENT 1 [2026-01-10]
- Triggered for: users sitting in negative UTC offset
- Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #1221, branch fix/plan-drift-1
- Outcome: backlog cleared 40 minutes after deploy

INCIDENT 2 [2026-05-12]
- Triggered for: clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root cause: a listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #5453, branch fix/plan-drift-5
- Outcome: job finished in 10 minutes instead of 9 hours

INCIDENT 3 [2026-05-16]
- Triggered for: situation after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #5640, branch fix/plan-drift-6
- Outcome: flaky test went from 20 failures per 100 runs to zero

INCIDENT 4 [2026-06-20]
- Triggered for: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: a race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #8284, branch fix/plan-drift-7
- Outcome: cold start dropped 6 percent, to 260 ms

Each incident represents a distinct manifestation of plan drift with different underlying causes, fixes, and measured improvements."}
